items.title: The Hawks officially waived Devin Carter.
items.author: Brad Rowland
items.body_excerpt:
The Hawks officially waived Devin Carter.

Atlanta has a well-documented roster crunch and still has 16 for 15 spots even after waiving Carter.

In June, the Hawks received a 2033 second round pick from SAC to take Carter’s ~$5.1M contract.

Atlanta also waived Lamont Butler today.

items.title: Inevitable that Hawks would waive Devin Carter, who will be one of league's strongest 2-way candidates now. Hawks still have to make one more move to get down to 15, whether it's a 2-for-1 trade or cutting one of Hield/Nembhard/Gueye

items.title: The Atlanta Hawks have waived Devin Carter, league sources told @hoopshypeofficial.bsky.social. The 24-year-old guard averaged 8.9 points, 3.3 rebounds and 2.7 assists in 18.4 minutes during 38 games played for the Sacramento Kings last season.

items.title: One way the Hawks could still take advantage of the Wolves situation is by receiving a pick (probably not much of a pick, but still) to trade Josh Green for Buddy Hield and Devin Carter. Wolves could stretch Carter, keep Hield. Also works with Ryan Nembhard in Carter's place.
